mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with subsequent tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with subsequent demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or UNRATE spike does not correlate with subsequent market downturns.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or FEDFUNDS decrease does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) and Real Final Sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% each over the past 3 months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 2% over 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month, coupled with an increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000, signals a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE drops > 0.5% and PAYEMS rises > 200k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or joint labor market improvement does not correlate with subsequent market rallies.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.5% signals increased borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with subsequent market downturns during tightening cycles.
